steps.name: And a KRS company is configured for NIP "5261040828"
And a COMPANY user is authenticated for registry tests
And the registry user has emailVerified set to false
When the user performs a registry lookup for NIP "5261040828"
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"nip":"5261040828","regon":"012345678","krs":"0000123456","companyName":"E2E Testowa Firma Sp. z o.o.","companyType":"SP_ZOO","legalFormName":"SPÓŁKA Z OGRANICZONĄ ODPOWIEDZIALNOŚCIĄ","street":"Marszałkowska","buildingNumber":"1","apartmentNumber":"10","city":"Warszawa","postalCode":"00-001","voivodeship":"MAZOWIECKIE","pkdMainCode":"62.01.Z","pkdMainDescription":"Działalność związana z oprogramo
When the user confirms company data for NIP "5261040828"
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"companyDataId":4,"nip":"5261040828","companyName":"E2E Testowa Firma Sp. z o.o.","companyType":"SP_ZOO","activated":false,"accountStatus":"IN_VALIDATION","message":"Company verified, awaiting email confirmation"}
And the confirm response activated should be false
And the confirm response accountStatus should be "IN_VALIDATION"
